purpose: Queue of assets that still ship as placeholders or are wanted but missing. An image-generation model reads this file, produces proper artwork for each open request, and a coding agent integrates the result.

status_values.placeholder: Project ships a stand-in (code drawing, procedural icon or reused sprite). Needs real art.
status_values.requested: Nothing ships yet. Needs real art before the feature can use it.
status_values.generated: Master delivered under the group's master_dir, not yet wired into the project.
status_values.integrated: Real art is in the project and its provenance is recorded. Entry can be deleted.

workflow_for_generator: Work only on requests whose status is placeholder or requested.
Read the group's output, style and prompt_template, then the request's subject and notes. Build the final prompt as prompt_template with {subject} replaced.
Attach the files listed in style.references and the group's references as style references. They are style guides, never edit targets.
Save each result unchanged at <group.output.master_dir>/<id>-v1.<group.output.format>. Never overwrite an existing version; bump to -v2 instead.
Save the exact prompt used at <group.output.prompt_dir>/<id>-v1.txt.

Set the request status to generated and fill generated.master, generated.prompt, generated.tool and generated.date (YYYY-MM-DD). Record model version and seed only if the tool exposes them; otherwise write null.
Do not edit project code, runtime atlases or provenance manifests. Integration is a separate coding step.
workflow_for_integration: Pick up requests with status generated, export the sizes listed in the group spec into public/, replace the stand-in, then set status integrated or delete the entry.

style.art_direction: src/styles/global.css tokens and the live site screenshots. Dark deep-space background, warm gold accent like the Golden Record.
style.palette: Background #04060c, panel #0b1020, text #e9edf5, gold accent #ffb547 with highlight #ffd38a, cyan #5ec8ff for Voyager 2.
style.forbidden: No text, letters, NASA logos or insignia, no watermarks. Do not copy the NASA meatball or JPL logo.

output.spec: Square SVG, viewBox 0 0 64 64, flat shapes, max 4 fills from the palette, must read at 16px. Also export PNG 180x180 (apple-touch-icon) and 512x512.

icons.prompt_template: Asset type: a minimal favicon for a website about the Voyager space probes. Flat vector, dark background, gold accent. Subject: {subject}

requests.subject: A simplified silhouette of the Voyager spacecraft seen from the front: the large round high-gain dish antenna dominant, a thin boom to one side, in gold on the dark background.
requests.notes: Keep it recognizable at 16px; the dish shape carries it.
